Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.

Or a vehicle runs a red light as you're approaching the intersection. That's when the Forward Collision and Cross Traffic Mitigation system comes to life. --When it senses an impending impact in front of you or on either side, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. 2025 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury 4WD
Command the road in the newly refreshed, technologically peerless benchmark of full-size luxury. This 2025 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury is a breathtaking One-Owner, Clean CARFAX, Cadillac Certified Pre-Owned recent arrival that represents the cutting edge of premium automotive engineering. Draped in the sophisticated, metallic depth of a Galactic Gray exterior over an opulent Jet Black Leather cabin, this four-wheel-drive (4WD) titan effortlessly fuses iconic V8 muscle with advanced towing systems and track-refined chassis hardware.

Cadillac Certified Pre-Owned: Elite Factory Protection
Driving a precision-engineered flagship deserves an equally elite level of mechanical and electronic certainty:

Unlimited Mile Warranty: Extends your security with an additional 12-Month/Unlimited Mile Limited Warranty that triggers the moment the vehicle's original factory plan expires.

172-Point Inspection: Scrutinized and reconditioned by factory-trained master technicians to guarantee peak performance.

$0 Deductible: Complete peace of mind with zero out-of-pocket costs for covered warranty repairs.

Continuous Concierge Care: Includes 24-hour Roadside Assistance, alternative courtesy transportation for the life of the warranty, a Transferable Warranty, and a comprehensive Vehicle History report.

Magnetic Ride Control & Performance Architecture
Engineered to deliver a glassy, completely isolated ride quality across unpredictable terrain, this Escalade features Cadillac's most celebrated suspension tuning:

Magnetic Ride Control Suspension: This world-class damping system reads the road surface up to 1,000 times per second, instantly adjusting shock stiffness to completely eliminate body roll and harsh highway vibrations.

Intelligent 4WD System: Armed with a 2-Speed Active Transfer Case and an Electronic Limited-Slip Differential (eLSD), which actively manages torque between the rear wheels to maximize dry-weather cornering agility and wet-weather traction.

6.2L V8 Muscle: A legendary, high-displacement natural powerhouse pushing massive horsepower and torque through a seamless 10-Speed Automatic transmission.

The Premium Luxury Sanctuary
The Preferred Equipment Group 1SB transforms the sprawling three-row interior into a first-class digital lounge:

Power Panoramic Sunroof: A massive tilt-sliding glass canopy that stretches overhead, flooding the cabin with natural Texas sunlight.

Climate-Controlled Comfort Matrix: Features multi-stage Heated & Ventilated Front Seats, power-adjustable driver and passenger configurations, and dedicated Heated Rear Seats.

AKG™ Studio 19-Speaker Audio: A professional-grade soundstage custom-tuned to the Escalade's unique interior acoustics to deliver rich, three-dimensional clarity.

Illuminating Sill Plates: Soft-glowing, premium front and rear entry plates greet you and your guests the moment the doors open.

Next-Gen Digital Cockpit & Smarter Towing
Reconfigurable Full-Color Head-Up Display: Projects critical driver telemetry, live navigation mapping, and active safety alerts directly onto the lower windshield.

Advanced Trailering Suite: Fully optioned for heavy-duty hauling, boasting Blind Zone Steering Assist with Trailering, an Integrated Trailer Brake Controller, Hitch Guidance with Hitch View, a Smart Trailer Indicator, and an onboard Trailering App with automated guidelines.

Surround-Shield Safety Grid: Equipped with an Exterior Parking Camera Rear, Brake Assist, and a comprehensive Theft-Deterrent Alarm System featuring glass breakage, vehicle inclination, and interior movement sensor arrays.

The Covert Commitment
Serving Central Texas since 1909, the Covert family has spent over a century building a flawless multi-generational legacy of trust, transparency, and top-tier guest care.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. With only 32,114 miles and a staggering feature list, this Escalade Sport Platinum is a once-in-a-generation opportunity. Call Victory Automotive Group for current pricing.
420HP 6.2L V8 & Magnetic Ride Control
The Escalade Sport Platinum is powered by the 6.2L V8 with Dynamic Fuel Management, producing 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 10-Speed Automatic Transmission. The 4WD system with electronic limited-slip differential, Air Ride Adaptive Suspension, and Magnetic Ride Control — reading the road every millisecond and adjusting damping in real time — deliver a ride quality that defies the Escalade's imposing size. Power-retractable running board assist steps, 22" 12-spoke polished alloy wheels with 275/50R22 tires, integrated trailer brake controller, and up to 7,500 lbs of towing capacity balance luxury with genuine capability.
Platinum Interior — Extraordinary in Every Detail
The Sport Platinum cabin is unlike anything else in the SUV segment. Full semi-aniline leather seating with 8-way power adjustment, 4-way lumbar, heated, ventilated, and massage function for both driver and passenger, heated second and third-row seats, heated steering wheel with memory, platinum leather-wrapped instrument panel and console, sueded microfiber headliner, genuine wood inserts, soft-close front and rear doors, illuminating door handles and sill plates, ambient interior lighting, power panoramic tilt-sliding sunroof, power-retractable running boards, and a cooled center console deliver an environment that simply cannot be replicated at this price.
Technology That Redefines the Segment
The Escalade Sport Platinum's technology suite is genuinely extraordinary. The 16.9" diagonal OLED infotainment screen — one of the largest and sharpest in any production vehicle — pairs with a 14.2" augmented reality cluster display that overlays navigation directions on a live camera feed of the road ahead. A reconfigurable full-color head-up display, AKG Studio Reference 36-speaker 3D surround sound system, Rear Seat Entertainment system with dual 12.6" HD touchscreens, two HDMI inputs, Bluetooth AKG headphones, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, SiriusXM with 360L, HD Radio, wireless charging, 110V power outlet, 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hotspot, adaptive remote start, universal home remote, and Cadillac Connected Access create a rolling technology showcase unlike anything else on the road.
Safety & Driver Assistance
The Escalade Sport Platinum's safety suite is equally impressive: Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Reverse Automatic Braking, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Rear Pedestrian Alert, Safety Alert Seat, HD Surround Vision, rear camera mirror with washer, front and rear park assist, StabiliTrak with Rollover Mitigation, Automatic Seat Belt Tightening, Buckle to Drive, and a multi-sensor theft deterrent system — including glass breakage, vehicle inclination, and interior movement sensors — provide comprehensive protection at every moment.
